name: westland
description: Westland Construction organizational plugin — always-loaded safety hooks and progressively-disclosed company style references. Install this first on every Westland machine (it's a required dependency of the domain plugins like scheduling, estimating, etc.). Contains: Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (modify-prompt on any existing file in the share, hard-deny in-place changes to .xer records and other version-controlled types, hard-deny deletes — move to _Archive / _to_delete instead) and a westland-house-style skill for formatting conventions on company documents.
